channel.title: Rizwan Zafar — Payments Essays
channel.description: Essays on payment infrastructure, fintech product, risk, settlement, AI and program leadership.

item.title: Syria Card Reconnection Needs Acceptance Proof
item.description: Syria's first international card transaction in over 15 years is an acceptance-readiness test across QNB, merchants, authorization, settlement and support.

item.title: Egypt Digital Financial Identity Needs Operating Proof
item.description: Egypt's digital financial identity rules make eKYC an operating model across banks, consent, authentication, data updates and support evidence.

item.title: Jaywan Acceptance Needs Payment Evidence, Not Just Logos
item.description: Jaywan acceptance is moving into airline, retail, online and network enablement. Operators need evidence across checkout, routing, settlement and support.

item.title: Aani's Next Product Problem Is Merchant Operating Adoption
item.description: Aani has scale in users and merchants. The next UAE instant-payments problem is repeat merchant use, exception ownership, reconciliation and evidence.

item.title: UAE Jaywan Rollout Needs a Scheme-Migration Control Room
item.description: Jaywan is now a UAE card rollout. The operator decision is how issuers, acquirers and merchants prove routing, 3DS, disputes and reconciliation.

item.title: Saudi Cashless Payments Need an Exception-Control Gate
item.description: Saudi retail payments are 85% electronic. The operator decision is how banks, PSPs and merchants control exceptions when digital is the default.

item.title: UAE Open Finance Pay by Bank Needs Checkout Gates
item.description: UAE Open Finance makes Pay by Bank a checkout option. The operator decision is consent, authentication, failure ownership, reconciliation and rollback.

item.title: UAE E-Invoicing Turns Finance Change Into Provider Readiness Gates
item.description: UAE e-invoicing makes finance transformation a provider-readiness programme across invoice data, tax reporting, onboarding, controls, and exceptions.

item.title: FedNow Intermediary Banks Turn Cross-Border Into A Rulebook Problem
item.description: FedNow intermediary-bank proposals show why cross-border instant payments need sanctions, settlement, exception, and respondent-bank controls.

item.title: OpenAI Daybreak Makes Cyber Agents An Access-Control Product
item.description: OpenAI Daybreak and GPT-5.6-Cyber show why powerful cyber agents need access tiers, scope, sandboxes, monitoring, and owner gates.

item.title: PSR APP Fraud Data Turns Reimbursement Into A Payments Control Loop
item.description: PSR APP fraud data shows UK payment firms need reimbursement, claims evidence, receiving-bank controls, CoP, and scam-source data in one loop.

item.title: Marqeta and Riskified Move False Declines Into Issuer Controls
item.description: Marqeta and Riskified show why issuer authorization needs merchant intelligence, fraud feedback, override rules, and false-decline evidence.

item.title: The Bank of England Just Turned Payment Vendor Risk Into a Programme Gate
item.description: The Bank of England's 2026 IOREP rules show why payment programmes need gates for material vendors, incidents, registers, and exit plans.

item.title: Checkout.com UAE SVF Approval Turns Liquidity Into a Payment Control
item.description: Checkout.com's UAE SVF in-principle approval shows why acquiring, issuing, liquidity, and fund controls must be governed together.

item.title: Solana Pay Shows Agent Payments Need Wallet Approval Controls
item.description: Solana Foundation's pay CLI shows why agent payments need wallet approval, spend policies, receipts, and fail-closed controls before scale.

item.title: GitHub Copilot Agent Metrics Make AI Adoption Governable
item.description: GitHub Copilot's agent-app metrics show why AI adoption needs agent-level evidence, cost controls, rollout rules, and governance.

item.title: Splitit and 1stMILE Make Installments an Issuer Control Surface
item.description: Splitit and 1stMILE's auto repair rollout shows why card-linked installments need issuer controls, merchant economics, and servicing proof.

item.title: UK Open Banking Has a Product Scale Scorecard Now
item.description: UK Open Banking's one-billion-payment milestone shows why product teams need scale metrics for reliability, consent, VRP, and disputes.

item.title: Worldline's Digital Euro Pilot Needs Programme Gates
item.description: Worldline and the ECB's digital euro pilot shows why payment pilots need gates for scope, acceptance, offline use, evidence, and rollout.

item.title: Adyen Personalize Turns Checkout Into a Product Control
item.description: Adyen Personalize shows why checkout PMs need controls for conversion, payment cost, shopper data, experiments, and risk.

item.title: OpenAI and Hugging Face Make AI Eval Containment a Product Gate
item.description: OpenAI and Hugging Face's July 2026 incident shows why AI evaluations need isolation, monitoring, scope, and stop conditions.

item.title: PwC and Label Show CARF Reporting Needs Programme Gates
item.description: PwC and Label's CARF collaboration shows why tax-transparency automation needs data, controls, vendor, and go-live gates.

item.title: Visa VIA Makes Acquirer Routing an Evidence Test
item.description: Visa Intelligent Authorisation shows why acquirers need routing evidence, resilience, and settlement visibility before auth modernization.

item.title: DeepMind's AI Control Roadmap Is a Programme Gate
item.description: DeepMind's AI Control Roadmap shows why agent programmes need measurable gates for monitoring, recall, response, and authority.

item.title: LoopX Shows Agent Teams Need a State Kernel
item.description: LoopX shows why long-running AI agent teams need durable goals, typed todos, evidence logs, gates, and handoffs.

item.title: OpenAI Presence Turns Agent Products Into Change Management
item.description: OpenAI Presence shows why product teams need evaluations, approval rules, escalation paths, and change control for agents.

item.title: Thredd and Pliant Make U.S. Credit Issuing a Control Test
item.description: Thredd and Pliant's U.S. commercial credit launch shows why issuer processing needs control ownership before growth.

item.title: Adyen's Peak Season Data Needs an Acquiring Control Room
item.description: Adyen's peak-season guide shows why acquiring teams need a control room for wallets, authorization, fraud, refunds, incidents, and learning.

item.title: Kaneo Shows Minimal PM Tools Still Need Governance Boundaries
item.description: Kaneo's minimal project-management model shows why delivery teams need simple boards, but regulated programmes still need governance outside the tool.

item.title: TencentDB Agent Memory Makes Recall a Governance Problem
item.description: TencentDB Agent Memory shows why agent recall needs ownership, visibility, backup, access control, and deletion rules before production use.
